images.filename: 356 Squadron RAF Liberator over Ramree Island Jan 1945 IWM C 4941.jpg
images.caption: IWM caption : A Consolidated Liberator B Mark VI of No. 356 Squadron RAF flies over Japanese positions on Ramree Island, which have just been bombed, on the day prior to the seaborne assault by 26th Indian Division.
images.alt: IWM caption : A Consolidated Liberator B Mark VI of No. 356 Squadron RAF flies over Japanese positions on Ramree Island, which have just been bombed, on the day prior to the seaborne assault by 26th Indian Division.

images.filename: 356 Squadron RAF Liberators bombing Ramree Island Jan 1945 IWM C 4940.jpg
images.caption: IWM caption : Three Consolidated Liberator B Mark VIs of No. 356 Squadron RAF, flying from the smoke-covered target area, after bombing Japanese positions on Ramree Island, Burma, prior to the seaborne assault by the 26th Indian Division.
images.alt: IWM caption : Three Consolidated Liberator B Mark VIs of No. 356 Squadron RAF, flying from the smoke-covered target area, after bombing Japanese positions on Ramree Island, Burma, prior to the seaborne assault by the 26th Indian Division.
